title: Cross-Org Initiative Synchronization Framework for Company Goals
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: As Redwood scales, several company-level initiatives span product, engineering, and design but lack a consistent mechanism for prioritization, dependency resolution, and executive visibility. That causes duplicated work, mis-timed rollouts, and quarterly OKR slippage.

Goal: Deliver a repeatable synchronization framework and lightweight operational tooling that ensures every company-level initiative has: a clear RACI, a quantifiable prioritization score, dependency map, milestone gates, and an OKR signal set so we can track health in the Redwood Console.

Proposed solution:
- Create an Initiative Triage Canvas (Confluence template) that captures outcome, primary metric, estimated effort, risks, security/compliance needs, and critical dependencies.
- Build a 5-point Synchronization Rubric (Impact, Effort, Customer Risk, Cross-Team Dependency, Regulatory) with scoring guidance and example benchmarks for common initiative types (runtime, private deployments, console).
- Surface an Initiative Alignment Heatmap in the Company OKR dashboard (read-only for execs, editable by initiative owners) that visualizes dependency clusters and timing conflicts.
- Define quarterly rituals:
  * Initiative Intake (PMs submit triage canvas before planning cycle)
  * Cross-Functional Triage (weekly 45m meeting during planning window)
  * Monthly OKR Health Review (exec + leads)
- Integrate with Linear: canonical tag "company-initiative" + required parent field so initiative tickets auto-link to the central triage canvas and heatmap.

Deliverables:
1) Confluence template + filled examples for 4 pilot initiatives.
2) Synchronization Rubric doc with scoring examples and a short training deck.
3) Linear automation rules / saved query to surface tag and dependencies.
4) Heatmap prototype in the Company OKR Dashboard (read-only link).
5) Pilot retrospective and iteration plan.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence 'Initiative Triage Canvas' template exists and is documented with two filled examples (runtime batching optimization; private deployment onboarding).
Synchronization Rubric has been reviewed and signed off by Eng, Design, Security, and GTM leads.
Linear automation created: tickets tagged 'company-initiative' appear in a single saved view and automatically link to parent triage doc.
Heatmap prototype deployed to the Company OKR Dashboard with at least 6 initiatives plotted and filters for quarter, owner, and dependency severity.
Pilot completed with retro notes and a prioritized backlog of follow-ups for Q2 rollout.

risks: Scoring subjectivity across teams; heatmap may require access to data currently restricted by privacy/compliance; overloaded leads during planning window could delay adoption.
mitigations: Provide explicit scoring examples and a 30m calibration session; limit heatmap fields to non-sensitive metadata; stagger pilot initiatives to avoid lead burnout.
